title: Predicates for scalar and refinement descent of semilinear exchange
statement: Use the fixed setting [def-pur-conventions], chosen Cartesian squares [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], compactifications and refinements [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], supplied exchange domains [def-exchange-projection], completed exchange [def-cbc-completed-exchange-map], raw rationalization [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], common-stage coefficients [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], the canonical maps and restricted domains of [fix-lem-exchanges], and the reindexing constructions [def-pur-semilinear-exchange-reindexing-data]. Name the following predicates on these fixed maps, asserting no proof. PurSemilinearRational is the ordered localized integral reindexing identity with the inverse quotient-completion unit. PurSemilinearScalar is the actual integral scalar-extension square, for every inclusion E<=F including equality, with the prescribed proper counit, open unit and completed-pullback comparisons. PurSemilinearCommonStage is existence of a normalized common-stage exchange model, its invertibility, its ordered integral representative at every finite stage, and its component represented at every larger common stage using the source and target beta comparisons. PurSemilinearRationalCoherence is the identity, successive-base-change and compatible-composition equations obtained by localizing the actual integral paths with retained constructible endpoints. PurSemilinearRefinement is the completed exchange/refinement equation, naturality, identity, transitivity, independence and cocycle of canonical common-refinement comparisons, and compatibility of the actual tower compositor with tower refinements. PurSemilinearFiniteCompactComparison is the finite chosen-to-independent compactification exchange formula through the canonical shriekIso comparisons. Every predicate retains the original field-base, witness, lattice, constructibility and amplitude domains and every canonical map of its existing definition; none chooses an arbitrary exchange or comparison.
